title: ReseedField inner loop increments wrong counter (i instead of j), bricking Field migration
description: The inner plot loop header is `for (uint j; j < accountPlots[i].plots.length; i++)` — it increments the outer index i instead of the inner index j. j never advances, and i is incremented inside the inner loop, leading to out-of-bounds access of accountPlots[i] and a revert (or, before reverting, repeated/incorrect indexing).
impact: ReseedField.init reverts for any input containing plots, so the migration upgrade cannot reseed the Field. Pods cannot be migrated to L2 — migration DoS / loss of field positions until patched.

ite.intent: Assign each account its plots exactly once and tally total pods
ite.technique: Loop post-statement increments the wrong variable (i not j)
ite.evasion: Deterministic; triggers on the first account with plots

ice_chain.corrupted_state: control flow: array index i runs out of bounds; s.sys.field.pods never finalized
ice_chain.consumer_function: FieldFacet harvest/sow and migration completion depend on Field reseed
ice_chain.impact: Migration transaction reverts; Field state never initialized on L2
ice_chain.exploit_path: ReseedField.init -> inner loop increments i -> accountPlots[i] OOB -> revert
